title: Scott Kirby Calls It a "Betrayal," Two Jets Get Fighter Escorts, and Lufthansa Retires a Legend
summary: United's CEO opens up about getting fired by American, defends charging you for a window seat, and wants a wealth tax — all in one wild interview. Plus, two different flights get intercepted by fighter jets in the same 24 hours, an American Eagle flight evacuates onto the wing in St. Louis, Lufthansa finally retires its last A340, and Wizz Air quietly wipes 20 cities off its map.
